title: Malu's Routine V3
author: Andre Assunção
desc: 7 day split, emphasis on legs; upper body development focused on chest and biceps. Follow the program...

ex.note: Normal barbell squat, but try to go deep with legs slightly more open. Maintain good posture otherwise lower back takes over; look upwards, chest up, avoid "good-morning" it.
Don't skip
Lean forwards, control the weight. Don't let your knees hyperextend.
You can do it with dumbbells or on the bar, use the whole leg.
Control the weight, maintain good posture. Careful to minimize shoulder involvement.
Shoulders and triceps, do it seated.
Stretch as much as possible, breath in to expand the ribs before extending. Focus on your lats. If you must, you can use do it on a cable.
Choose the attachment you prefer, but control the stretch.
(Or overhead)You can use any attachment, would recommend the rope. Focus on maintaining your arm stable to avoid elbow pain.
Do not go for low reps in this movement, you will rip your bicep tendon. You can also use the station if they don't have the machine.
You can begin with a 5 minutes warmup (rowing), then ramp up the intensity. Record your time, and try increasing it every week until you can row for 25-30 minutes; then, increase the resistance.
You know what this is for...

ex.n: Split Squat Front Foot Elevated (Smith Machine)
ex.note: Control the weight, do not bounce on the lower leg. Avoid even touching the lower leg, you can begin with no weight on the bar.
Focus on stretching the hamstring, you need to go slow for this. You can use a decline if comfortable.
Don't skip
Put the seat as far back as possible, let the quads stretch. Do a drop set here, suffer as much as possible.
Use the best machine available, focus on letting the chest stretch by maintaining good posture (chest up, shoulders back)
Control the weight, maintain good posture. You can also use a machine if available.
Stretch as much as possible, focus on the lats. If not available, do the dumbbell pullover.
Choose the attachment you prefer, but control the stretch.
(Or overhead) You can use any attachment, would recommend the rope. For this day, you can do Arnold press if you can't do the pushdown.
Do not go for low reps in this movement, you will rip your bicep tendon. You can also use the station if they don't have the machine.
All on glutes and hamstring.
Don't skip.
Lean forwards, control the weight. Don't let your knees hyperextend.
Yes...
Remember here: The most important part of the movement is not the kickback itself, but rather controlling the way back. Stay as far as possible from the cable station, control the leg all the way.
You can row, cycle, or do the stairs. Focus on actually working your cardio, it's not about the calories.
Hum...
Optional, do something to relax. Can be further stretching, sauna... or nothing.
